summary: The open AI model repository and developer inference ecosystem has matured significantly by 2026, with Hugging Face remaining the dominant hub hosting over 2 million models while specialized inference platforms like Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow compete on cost and speed. The ecosystem is highly concentrated, with the top 0.01% of models accounting for nearly half of all downloads, and Chinese models like Qwen and DeepSeek driving major adoption momentum alongside Western alternatives. Developers now have a rich spectrum of options spanning cloud inference APIs, local desktop runners, and serverless GPU compute, reducing dependence on any single platform.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: Central open-source model repository and community hub for sharing, discovering, and running AI models, datasets, and Spaces demos
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public model hosting and limited inference; Pro plan ~$9/month; Inference Endpoints from ~$0.06/hour; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month
features: Largest open model repository with 2M+ models
Inference Providers tier routing to partners like Together AI, Fireworks AI, and DeepInfra
Spaces for hosting live demos and Gradio/Streamlit apps
Datasets and evaluation leaderboards
Fine-tuning and AutoTrain tools
Top models include Llama (476M cumulative downloads), DeepSeek (128.2M), Mistral (124.3M), and Qwen
Supports private model hosting and access-gated models
Active community forums and model cards
platforms.best_for: Researchers, open-source contributors, and developers who need model discovery, versioning, and community collaboration in one place

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local model runner that lets developers download and run open-source LLMs on their own hardware with a simple CLI and REST API
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; costs are only hardware/electricity
features: One-command model pull and run (e.g. ollama run llama3)
OpenAI-compatible REST API for easy app integration
Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows with GPU acceleration
Model library covers Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Phi, and more
Modelfile system for custom model configuration and system prompts
No data leaves the local machine — full privacy
Active community with millions of desktop installs
platforms.best_for: Privacy-conscious developers, hobbyists, and enterprises that need fully offline inference without sending data to external APIs

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Serverless API platform for running open-source AI models in the cloud with pay-per-second billing and no infrastructure management
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second GPU usage; CPU from ~$0.0001/sec, T4 GPU ~$0.00055/sec, A100 ~$0.0023/sec; no subscription required
features: Largest hosted catalog of open-source models with 50K+ options
Instant API endpoint for any model with no setup
Supports image, video, audio, and language models
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Deployments feature for dedicated, always-on endpoints
Fine-tuning support for Stable Diffusion and select LLMs
Simple Python and Node.js SDKs
Webhook support for async predictions
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups that want quick API access to a wide variety of open-source models including multimodal ones without managing GPUs

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: Low-cost cloud inference platform offering OpenAI-compatible APIs for open-source LLMs with a focus on speed and affordability
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; e.g. Llama 3.1 8B at ~$0.10/M tokens, Llama 3.1 70B at ~$0.88/M tokens; free $25 credit on signup
features: OpenAI-compatible API for drop-in replacement in existing apps
Among the lowest published inference prices for flagship open models
Supports Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, and more
Together Inference Engine optimized for high throughput
Fine-tuning API with LoRA support
Dedicated endpoints for latency-sensitive workloads
Batch inference for cost-efficient bulk processing
Used as a backend inference provider inside Hugging Face
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers and companies running high-volume LLM inference who want open-model flexibility with a familiar OpenAI-style API

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance inference platform for open-source models emphasizing speed, reliability, and production-grade SLAs
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; Llama 3.1 8B from ~$0.10/M tokens; serverless and dedicated deployment options available
features: FireAttention proprietary inference engine for faster token generation
OpenAI-compatible API
Supports function calling and JSON mode across models
Compound AI and multi-model routing capabilities
Dedicated deployments with guaranteed capacity
Fine-tuning with LoRA and full fine-tune options
On-premises and VPC deployment options for enterprise
Listed as a direct Hugging Face Inference Provider partner
platforms.best_for: Production engineering teams that need fast, reliable open-model inference with advanced features like function calling and structured outputs

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: All-in-one AI model hosting and inference platform recognized for high-performance inference and strong value, particularly popular in Asia-Pacific markets
platforms.pricing: Competitive pay-per-token pricing; rated best overall value for combined hosting and inference in 2026 comparisons; free tier available
features: Ranked #1 for value among AI model hosting platforms in 2026
Faster inference speeds cited versus comparable platforms
Hosts both open-source and proprietary models
Supports text, image, and multimodal models
OpenAI-compatible API
Strong support for Qwen, DeepSeek, and other popular open models
Combined hosting and inference in a single platform
Growing Western market presence alongside dominant Asia-Pacific user base
platforms.best_for: Organizations seeking cost-efficient, high-throughput inference particularly for Chinese open-source models like Qwen and DeepSeek

platforms.name: DeepInfra
platforms.purpose: Serverless inference API for open-source LLMs and embedding models with competitive pricing and broad model support
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; among the lowest cost providers, e.g. Llama 3.1 8B from ~$0.055/M tokens
features: Very low per-token pricing across a wide model catalog
OpenAI-compatible REST API
Supports LLMs, embedding models, and image generation
Streaming responses supported
Listed as a Hugging Face Inference Provider partner
No infrastructure setup required
Simple usage dashboard and API key management
platforms.best_for: Budget-conscious developers and researchers needing reliable serverless inference at the lowest possible cost

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified API gateway that routes requests across dozens of AI model providers, enabling model switching and cost optimization from a single endpoint
platforms.pricing: Pass-through pricing from underlying providers plus a small margin; free models available; pay-per-token
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API key for models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Meta, and open-source providers
Automatic fallback routing if a provider is unavailable
Model comparison and cost tracking dashboard
Supports both proprietary and open-source models
Provider preference and load-balancing controls
Prompt caching support where available
Listed as a recommended inference routing layer alongside Hugging Face Inference Providers
platforms.best_for: Developers and teams that want to experiment across many models or build resilient apps without being locked into a single inference provider

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: Python-first serverless cloud compute platform for running ML inference, training jobs, and data pipelines on GPUs with full code control
platforms.model_count: No fixed catalog — run any model from code
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second GPU usage; A10G ~$0.00306/sec, A100 ~$0.00405/sec; free $30/month credit for hobbyists
features: Deploy any Python function or model as a serverless GPU endpoint in minutes
Cold-start optimization with container snapshotting
Scales to zero when idle, scales up instantly on demand
Persistent volumes for model weight caching
Supports vLLM, Transformers, Diffusers, and custom inference stacks
Built-in job scheduling and batch processing
Web endpoint generation with automatic HTTPS
Recommended as a Hugging Face Spaces and inference alternative
platforms.best_for: ML engineers and developers who want full control over their inference stack and environment without managing Kubernetes or cloud infrastructure

platforms.name: Baseten
platforms.purpose: Production inference deployment platform for custom and open-source models with a focus on low latency, high throughput, and enterprise reliability
platforms.model_count: No fixed catalog — deploy any model
platforms.pricing: Usage-based GPU pricing; dedicated and autoscaling deployment options; pricing on request for enterprise
features: Truss open-source framework for packaging any model for deployment
Optimized serving with TensorRT-LLM and vLLM backends
Autoscaling from zero to high concurrency
Private VPC deployment options
Pre-built pipelines for popular models like Llama and Stable Diffusion
Detailed observability, logging, and latency metrics
Async and streaming inference support
Recommended as a production-grade Hugging Face hosting alternative
platforms.best_for: ML platform teams at growth-stage and enterprise companies that need production-grade, low-latency custom model deployments with strong observability

platforms.name: RunPod
platforms.purpose: GPU cloud marketplace offering raw GPU rental for model training, fine-tuning, and self-hosted inference at competitive prices
platforms.model_count: No fixed model catalog — full user control of environment
platforms.pricing: Spot GPUs from ~$0.20/hr (RTX 3090); on-demand A100 80GB from ~$1.99/hr; persistent and serverless pod options
features: Wide selection of consumer and data-center GPUs at competitive hourly rates
Serverless GPU endpoints for autoscaling inference
Pre-built templates for Ollama, ComfyUI, vLLM, and JupyterLab
Persistent storage volumes for model weights
Network volumes shared across pods
Community-contributed pod templates
SSH and Jupyter access for full environment control
Recommended for raw GPU rental as a Hugging Face infrastructure alternative
platforms.best_for: Researchers, fine-tuners, and developers who need affordable raw GPU access for training or self-hosted inference without committing to hyperscaler pricing

platforms.name: LM Studio
platforms.purpose: Desktop application for discovering, downloading, and running open-source LLMs locally on Mac, Windows, and Linux with a chat UI and local server
platforms.model_count: Thousands accessible via Hugging Face integration
platforms.pricing: Free for personal use; LM Studio Pro for commercial use
features: User-friendly GUI for non-technical users to run local LLMs
Built-in Hugging Face model search and one-click download
Local OpenAI-compatible server for connecting apps like Cursor or Open WebUI
Supports GGUF quantized models via llama.cpp backend
Hardware compatibility checker for model selection
Multi-model chat and comparison features
Privacy-first — fully offline operation
Recommended alongside Ollama for local model running
platforms.best_for: Non-technical users and developers on personal hardware who want a polished desktop experience for running local LLMs without using a terminal
